retention_window: 2025-09 to 2026-09 (MRR on the last day of each month)
headline_findings: NRR is 107.3% and GRR is 94.2%: 284 of expansion MRR more than covered the 126 lost to contraction and cancellations. 11 of 40 accounts expanded (27.5%).
Starter is the weak plan: NRR 88.5% and GRR 68.8%, against 114.4% NRR on Growth. Yet 6 of the 12 ready accounts are on Starter, and 6 of those tried to add a second staff member and were blocked.
The staff limit is the biggest moment: 9 ready accounts and 212 MRR at stake. No live email covers it; the Starter upgrade nudge flow is still a draft.
2 Growth accounts went past the SMS allowance, worth 30 MRR in packs, and no email fires at 80% or 100%.

total.math: NRR = end MRR 2332 / start MRR 2174 = 107.3%. Start 2174 + expansion 284 - contraction 31 - churned 95 = 2332. GRR = (start 2174 - contraction 31 - churned 95) / 2174 = 94.2%.

floor_target.math: 9 accounts x 27.5% past expansion rate = 2.48, rounded up to 3; MRR 212 x 27.5% = 58

upgrade_moments.in_product_prompt: Shows when an owner tries to add a staff member past the allowance. Says how many staff the next step includes and the monthly price difference, keeps the invite saved so it sends the moment the account upgrades, and has a plain "not now" that leaves the invite pending. Screen design: paywall-screen-optimizer.
upgrade_moments.email: Trigger: invite blocked and no upgrade within 2 hours. Subject idea: "Your invite to [name] is waiting". Body: the pending invite, what the next step adds, the price difference, one button. One reminder after 3 days; stop on upgrade or when the invite is deleted.
upgrade_moments.account_manager_step: Within 2 business days of the trigger: a short call or reply offering to add the seats and set up the new staff calendars with them.
upgrade_moments.emails_running_today: not live: Starter upgrade nudge (draft). Nothing sends today.

floor_target.math: 2 accounts x 27.5% past expansion rate = 0.55, rounded up to 1; MRR 30 x 27.5% = 8

upgrade_moments.in_product_prompt: Banner on the reminders screen at 80% of the monthly allowance, and a blocking notice at 100% that says how many reminders are on hold and what one pack adds. Never hold a reminder silently. Screen design: paywall-screen-optimizer.
upgrade_moments.email: Trigger: 80% of the allowance used. Subject idea: "[n] reminders left this month". Body: texts used, the no-show cost of reminders that do not send, pack price. Second send at 100% with the count on hold.
upgrade_moments.account_manager_step: Only for routed accounts: offer the right number of packs before the next billing date.

floor_target.math: 1 account x 27.5% past expansion rate = 0.28, rounded up to 1; MRR 18 x 27.5% = 5

upgrade_moments.in_product_prompt: On a click on advanced reports, show a preview built from the account's own last month with the numbers blurred, and the plan that includes it. Screen design: paywall-screen-optimizer.
upgrade_moments.email: Trigger: 3 or more clicks in 30 days. Subject idea: "Your [month] report is ready to unlock". Body: what the report shows, the plan and price difference.
upgrade_moments.account_manager_step: Only for routed accounts: walk through the report on a call.

targets.read_out_rule: launch + 45 days (one full monthly billing cycle plus two weeks), moved to Monday if it lands on a weekend
targets.math: floor 71 / current MRR 2790 = 2.5 points of next year's NRR, if contraction and cancellations stay where they are (an estimate)
targets.decision_rule: At the read-out, a moment that reached its floor stays and gets a goal above it; a moment below its floor changes one thing (trigger timing, message or offer) and runs another cycle.
